name: 40444 · Lancaster, KY
findings: ZIP 40444 (Lancaster) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 40444 (Lancaster) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
